text_events.text: Not every day needs a story.
Your perfect Sunday, in three words?

production_notes: Four quiet clips are joined with 0.4-second cross-dissolves for a 12-second final duration.
Keep motion low and let the longest visual ideas breathe; avoid speed ramps and busy effects.
The procedural score is deliberately soft. The silent master is equally valid for this concept.
Curated Pexels material must not be described as personally filmed.
Human visual and audio approval is required before scheduling.

checklist: Watch both MP4 masters from start to finish; confirm all three cross-dissolves are clean and calm.
Inspect cover and contact sheet; confirm text is readable over the sunlit room.
Confirm source pages, creators, license evidence, and SHA-256 hashes in manifest.json.
Confirm 1080 x 1920, H.264, 12-second duration, and audio-stream checks passed.
Listen once with the procedural score and once silent; choose the quieter option per platform.
Confirm there is no watermark, false personal-filming claim, or unlicensed external audio.
Add platform music natively and record the actual track in this file.
Verify caption, CTA, hashtags, cover, date, time zone, and preview before scheduling.
